name: Hacker News API
operator: Y Combinator (Hacker News API hosted on Google Firebase)
tier_rationale: Y Combinator is an established company with published terms (A8 trusted); P109 cond 4 'Registry providers hacker_news (Y Combinator) and algolia: tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: Authoritative for Hacker News accounts and items; the 'about' text is self-asserted by the account owner (P109 cond 2).

firebase_api.title: Hacker News Firebase API v0 (user/{u}.json, item/{id}.json)

terms.quote: Registry providers hacker_news (Y Combinator) and algolia: tier trusted, terms open; personal_data_review before default use (A3 BR8).

firebase_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P109 cond 4); research C0248 terms '[gh_people] HN API terms (public)' / '[live_osint] Public HN API (Y Combinator).' (verified_live 200); the evidence URL is the official API documentation. hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/user/{u}.json and /v0/item/{id}.json; HTTP 200 with body 'null' = ABSENT, decided from the JSON (P109 cond 1); the username is validated against [A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,15} first (P109 cond 2). Keep links, dates and matched items only (P109 cond 3). Used by hackernews and username_check.

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G05-2, p3-G05-1 (P109, P113): batches only extend it (hacker_news__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). A third-party app hosted on firebaseio.com belongs to its real operator; hn.algolia.com is the separate provider algolia (P109). No documented rate limit (research C0248): no quota block. Usernames are PERSONAL_TYPES: personal_data_review before default use (P109 cond 4).
